ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    u.subsit,
    l.zoncod AS location_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS u
INNER JOIN live3.locatn AS l
    ON l.subsit = u.subsit
   AND l.locatn = u.locatn
GROUP BY
    u.subsit,
    l.zoncod
ORDER BY
    u.subsit,
    l.zoncod;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod,
    COUNT(DISTINCT iv.ulid20) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.agv_inventory_view AS iv
WHERE iv.locatn IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod
ORDER BY
    iv.subsit,
    iv.zoncod;
